title: SwiftUI Agent Skill: Install and use with AI coding tools
summary: Antoine van der Lee demonstrates a focused SwiftUI review that exposes nested scroll containers and duplicated selection synchronization between a view and its view model. He explains how a compact skill routes agents to relevant references, giving teams concrete findings to inspect instead of treating generated SwiftUI as already reviewed.
takeaway: Ask agents to review scroll ownership and state synchronization explicitly, then verify each proposed change against the actual view hierarchy and source of truth.
